dialogue.speech: Your ability gave me an excellent hint.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Your ability is similar to my Golden Wind.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: They're very much alike in the way that they both recreate something.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Due to the hint you gave me, and almost being k*lled,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: it would appear...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: that I've grown a little.

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: M-Melone, did you hear that?

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: I totally forgot earlier, but now I know the newbie's Stand ability.

dialogue.name: Melone
dialogue.speech: What about the newbie?

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: His button has become an eye! In his hand! It became an eyeball!

dialogue.name: Melone
dialogue.speech: Hey, Babyhead, what are you talking about?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: What's this about the dead newbie?

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: He inserted the eye into his face!

dialogue.name: Smack,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HDD&\c&HC&}Rum{\c&HACF&}ble

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: He did the same with his throat and leg!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: His ability is to create life!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: He created his own parts!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: His ability is the exact opposite of mine!

dialogue.name: Melone
dialogue.speech: Hey, who the hell are you talking about?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: You're not getting away! Golden Wind!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: The newbie... He...

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: He's been revived!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: A-Are you listening, Melone?

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: He made parts of the motorcycle into roots!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: I can't separate them!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I have to get rid of the parts that are stuck!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: I need to get away from the bike!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Did it turn into a rock again?

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: This isn't good. He's going to try to pick up the turtle.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: I'll k*ll him before he picks it up!

dialogue.name: Melone
dialogue.speech: Calm down, Babyhead!

dialogue.name: Melone
dialogue.speech: Let him pick up the turtle.

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: What do you mean?

dialogue.name: Melone
dialogue.speech: The moment he picks up the turtle, tear him apart for good.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Oil's pouring out. That's not good!

dialogue.name: Melone
dialogue.speech: Make sure he can never get up again!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: I got him!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: It was only a little bit, but how dare you freak me out, you b*stard?!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: Now, I'm going to rip your head—

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I've learned a lot from your ability to turn humans into objects.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I'm not sure if it's fate or if our Stands were attracted to each other

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: due to their similarities that we met.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: But because of you, my Golden Wind was able to grow.

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: Wh-Where did it go?

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: I just tore off your wrist. Where did it go?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Tore off?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: That's incorrect.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I intentionally let it go.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I'd like to give you a little advice.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: You should probably use your hand to defend yourself, rather than attack me.

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: D-Don't you dare underestimate me!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: Take this!

dialogue.name: Baby
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The hand that I cut off has already become another living creature

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: and invaded your body.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Yes.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: As you can see, it turned into a piranha!
